          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (for example MR, MRS,
            MS or DR). When present it is used to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: MR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility with the flat address form; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this value is ignored.
            On output this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address of the pet owner.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present. An owner is valid
            when it supplies an address in EITHER form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'). Normalized on create
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address of the pet
            owner (for example a unit or apartment number). Normalized on create
            like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be four digits and, when the owner's city has a known region
            (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), must fall within that
            region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise the
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to
            15 digits. For example '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-11'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when present it is used to derive the ageBand against the
            registrationDate. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time hint that this owner deliberately shares a household
            with an existing owner. When true, the duplicate-household check
            (same last name and address) is bypassed. Optional; defaults to
            false and is not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the optional 'title' (MR/MRS/MS/DR)
                followed by a single space and the last name, or just the last
                name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'MR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone number formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes from the left and separated by spaces. The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form. For example the stored
                '+61412345678' is displayed as '+61 412 345 678'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name
                and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the household (same last name and
                address). Assigned when an owner deliberately joins an existing
                same-last-name owner at the same address via 'sharesHousehold';
                every owner in that household carries the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this
                owner was created, sharing the same first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year that contains the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year's starting calendar year. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (matching
                fiscalYear) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Points
                start at 0 and gain 2 when an email address is present, 1 when
                the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a
                household of 3 or more members, and 3 when the owner's tenure
                exceeds one year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the
                fixed table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using the fixed table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from the optional birthDate,
                computed against the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18,
                'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when
                no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today
                (on the same registration date) at the time this owner was
                created, otherwise false. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                A new owner is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone; otherwise false. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a
                possible duplicate of. Absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record. Owners flagged deleted are ignored by the create
                endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A relative link to this owner's canonical resource, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

## Summary

I redesigned the owner identity key and duplicate-detection logic to match the spec.

**`Owner.java`** (`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`)
- `getIdentityKey()` now returns the lower-case hex **SHA-256** digest of `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)` (a 64-hex string), replacing the old plaintext `telephone|email|householdId` key.
- Added a standard **American Soundex** implementation (`soundex`/`soundexDigit`) and a `sha256Hex` helper.

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** (`addOwner`)
- The 409 duplicate check still runs on `identityKey`, still ignoring soft-deleted owners, with the email-domain blocklist applied first — unchanged in structure but now keyed on the new SHA-256 identity.
- **Removed** the separate household-duplicate 409 block (the one derived from the computed `householdId`). Two owners with the same last name and postcode but different telephones now have different identity keys, so both are created.
- **Replaced** the hardcoded `possibleDuplicate = false` with the new **soft-match**: when the new owner's identity key differs from all existing (non-deleted) owners but its `soundex(lastName)` **and** postcode match one, it's flagged `possibleDuplicate = true` / `possibleDuplicateOf = <earliest matching owner id>`.
- Kept `householdId`, `householdSize`, and the membership-level cap logic intact (still needed by other checkpoints).

**`openapi.yml`** — updated the `identityKey` field description/example to reflect the SHA-256 formula.

Key behaviour-change checkpoints (Cp10, Cp35 soft-match; Cp28, Cp52 SHA-256 shape + collision; Cp03/Cp25 identity 409) all pass, along with the household/membership tests (Cp11, Cp23, Cp39, Cp51) that depend on the retained household logic.
